name: ontos
description: ontos monorepo root — npm workspaces wiring the @bitspark/ontos-* TypeScript packages so they resolve each other by name in-repo exactly as published. Not itself published.
//workspaces: ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING. A release publishes the packages in this dependency order (core before codec before data before data-json), because a dependent must not reach the registry before its dependency, and scripts/check.sh, scripts/check.ps1 and ci.yml derive the build, test and lint set from it, so a package absent here is skipped everywhere. Do NOT alphabetise. cli/ts is a workspace and is not published.
